LESSON: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Belief in revealed scriptures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in revealed scriptures. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can Muslims practise religious tolerance?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman
2. explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind
3. identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance
4. describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance
5. practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES
This lesson teaches Belief in revealed scriptures for Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Belief in revealed scriptures using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Belief in revealed scriptures above.
2. Explain Belief in revealed scriptures to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Belief in revealed scriptures.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in revealed scriptures with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in revealed scriptures important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can Muslims practise religious tolerance?
2. Why does mankind need revealed scriptures?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman
2. explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind
3. identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance
4. describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
